mnemonic.meaning: Criticize (批) and evaluate (評). A critique, a review.
mnemonic.reading: HE, HYO (ひひょう): "He-he, yo!" the critic laughs at your movie.

examples.ja: 新聞に映画の批評が出た。
examples.en: A review of the film appeared in the paper.

items.note: Reviews of art and books. 批判 (ひはん) is criticism, usually negative.

mnemonic.meaning: Sail (航) the sea (海). A voyage.
mnemonic.reading: COKE, KITE (こうかい): on the voyage you fly a kite and drink Coke. Same sound as 後悔 (regret).

examples.ja: 船は長い航海に出た。
examples.en: The ship set out on a long voyage.

items.note: Sea travel. 航空 is air travel.

mnemonic.meaning: The study (学) of how things transform (化). Chemistry.
mnemonic.reading: CAR, GACK (かがく): chemistry class: the car fumes make you GACK. Same sound as 科学 (science).

examples.ja: 化学の実験は面白い。
examples.en: Chemistry experiments are interesting.

items.note: To avoid confusion, people say ばけがく for 化学.

mnemonic.meaning: 琴 has two 王 (jewels) on top: a fancy instrument with strings. A Japanese harp.
mnemonic.reading: KOTO (こと): "CO-TOE": you pluck the koto with your toe.

examples.ja: 祖母は琴を弾く。
examples.en: My grandmother plays the koto.

items.note: A 13-string zither. 弾く (ひく) = play strings.

mnemonic.meaning: The big (大) envoy (使). An ambassador.
mnemonic.reading: TIE, SHE (たいし): she wears a tie as ambassador.

examples.ja: 彼は日本大使としてフランスに行った。
examples.en: He went to France as Japan's ambassador.

items.note: 大使館 = embassy.

mnemonic.meaning: 挿 has 扌 (hand): your hand inserts a flower.
mnemonic.reading: SA, SUE (さす): Sue inserts a flower into the vase.

examples.ja: 花瓶に花を挿した。
examples.en: I put flowers in a vase.

items.note: 差す / 挿す both used. コンセントを差す = plug in.

mnemonic.meaning: 句 is 勹 (wrap) around 口 (mouth): words wrapped together. A phrase.
mnemonic.reading: COO (く): the pigeon coos a short phrase. 俳句 (haiku).

examples.ja: この句の意味を先生に聞いた。
examples.en: I asked the teacher what this verse meant.

items.note: 文句 (complaint), 句読点 (punctuation).

mnemonic.meaning: 覚 is wake up: you wake someone else.
mnemonic.reading: SAM'S SOUP (さます): the smell of Sam's soup wakes you up.

examples.ja: 大きな音で目を覚ました。
examples.en: A loud noise woke me up.

items.note: Transitive partner of 覚める (Level 14). 目を覚ます = to wake up.

mnemonic.meaning: Small (小) grain (麦). Wheat.
mnemonic.reading: COME, MOO, GEE (こむぎ): "Come, moo," the cow says to the wheat. Gee!

examples.ja: パンは小麦から作られる。
examples.en: Bread is made from wheat.

items.note: 小麦粉 = flour. 大麦 = barley.

mnemonic.meaning: Move (動) somewhere different (異). A transfer.
mnemonic.reading: EE, DOUGH (いどう): you're transferred to the dough department. Same sound as 移動.

examples.ja: 四月に大阪支社へ異動になった。
examples.en: I was transferred to the Osaka branch in April.

items.note: For job transfers inside a company. 移動 is physically moving.

mnemonic.meaning: Drawings (図) and books (書). Books, as in 図書館 (library).
mnemonic.reading: TOE SHOW (としょ): the books show your toe.

examples.ja: 図書館で本を借りた。
examples.en: I borrowed books from the library.

items.note: Mostly in 図書館 (library), 図書室.

mnemonic.meaning: Copper (銅) money (貨). A copper coin.
mnemonic.reading: DOUGH, CAR (どうか): you need copper coins to buy dough for the car.

examples.ja: 古い銅貨を見つけた。
examples.en: I found an old copper coin.

items.note: 10円玉 is a 銅貨. 金貨 / 銀貨 = gold / silver coin.

mnemonic.meaning: 論 is argument: to argue, to debate.
mnemonic.reading: RON, GEE, RUE (ろんじる): Ron debates, "Gee, you'll rue it!"

examples.ja: その問題について論じた。
examples.en: We discussed that issue.

items.note: Formal and academic. 話し合う is everyday.

mnemonic.meaning: "EAR-AH, EAR-AH (いらいら)!" Someone keeps shouting in your ear. You're irritated.

examples.ja: 電車が遅れていらいらした。
examples.en: I got irritated when the train was late.

items.note: Usually いらいらする. むかむか is anger or nausea.

mnemonic.meaning: Two receive kanji (享, 受): receive and enjoy. Enjoying benefits.
mnemonic.reading: KYO, JUICE (きょうじゅ): in Kyoto you enjoy the benefits of fresh juice. Same sound as 教授 (professor).

examples.ja: 私たちは科学の進歩の恩恵を享受している。
examples.en: We are enjoying the benefits of scientific progress.

items.note: Formal; enjoying rights or benefits. 楽しむ is everyday enjoyment.

mnemonic.meaning: Hard (硬) money (貨). A coin.
mnemonic.reading: COKE-A (こうか): you put a coin in the Coke machine.

examples.ja: 自動販売機に硬貨を入れた。
examples.en: I put coins into the vending machine.

items.note: Formal word for coins. 小銭 (Level 20) is small change. 紙幣 = banknote.

mnemonic.meaning: Skilled (技) expert (師). An engineer.
mnemonic.reading: GEE, SHE (ぎし): "Gee, she's a great engineer!"

examples.ja: 彼は電気技師だ。
examples.en: He's an electrical engineer.

items.note: Slightly old; エンジニア / 技術者 are common now.

mnemonic.meaning: Pull (引) a quote and use (用) it. A citation.
mnemonic.reading: IN, YO (いんよう): "In quotes, yo!"

examples.ja: 論文に有名な言葉を引用した。
examples.en: I quoted a famous saying in my paper.

items.note: 引用文 = a quotation.

mnemonic.meaning: Go up (上) to the capital (京). Moving to Tokyo.
mnemonic.reading: JOE, KYO (じょうきょう): Joe moves to Tokyo. Same sound as 状況 (situation).

examples.ja: 彼は十八歳で上京した。
examples.en: He moved to Tokyo at eighteen.

items.note: Going to Tokyo from elsewhere in Japan, usually to live.

mnemonic.meaning: 宛 is address: you direct a letter to someone.
mnemonic.reading: AH, TERRY (あてる): "Ah, Terry!" You address the letter to him.

examples.ja: 母に宛てて手紙を書いた。
examples.en: I wrote a letter addressed to my mother.

items.note: Usually 〜に宛てて. 宛先 = address, recipient. 〜宛 on envelopes = "to".

mnemonic.meaning: 霜 has 雨 (rain) on top: frozen moisture. Frost.
mnemonic.reading: SHE MOW (しも): she mows the lawn covered in frost.

examples.ja: 今朝は畑に霜が降りた。
examples.en: There was frost on the fields this morning.

items.note: 霜が降りる = frost forms. 霜焼け = chilblains.

mnemonic.meaning: Cut (断) across sideways (横). Crossing.
mnemonic.reading: OH, DAN (おうだん): "Oh, Dan!" He crosses the street. 横断歩道 = crosswalk.

examples.ja: 横断歩道を渡ってください。
examples.en: Please use the pedestrian crossing.

items.note: 横断歩道 = crosswalk. Also crossing a continent: アメリカ横断.

mnemonic.meaning: The source (源) where it rises (起). The origin.
mnemonic.reading: KEY, GEN (きげん): the origin of the key. Same sound as 機嫌 (mood).

examples.ja: この祭りの起源は古い。
examples.en: This festival has old origins.

items.note: Formal. 始まり (Level 7) is everyday.

mnemonic.meaning: Public (公) and correct (正). Fair, just.
mnemonic.reading: COKE, SAY (こうせい): "Fair Coke for everyone," they say.

examples.ja: 公正な判断をお願いします。
examples.en: Please make a fair judgement.

items.note: Formal; justice and rules. 公平 (Level 15) is treating everyone equally.

mnemonic.meaning: 慣 is get used to: you make something get used to it. To break in.
mnemonic.reading: NARA, SUE (ならす): in Nara, Sue tames the deer.

examples.ja: 新しい靴を少しずつ足に慣らした。
examples.en: I gradually broke in my new shoes.

items.note: Transitive of 慣れる. 体を慣らす = to get your body used to something.

mnemonic.meaning: CAR, YOU, EE (かゆい): you sit in the car and your leg is so itchy. Eee!

examples.ja: 蚊に刺されたところがかゆい。
examples.en: My mosquito bite is itchy.

items.note: Kanji: 痒い. かゆみ = itchiness.

mnemonic.meaning: Prize (賞) goods (品). A trophy, a prize.
mnemonic.reading: SHOW, HEN (しょうひん): the hen wins the prize at the show.

examples.ja: 一位の賞品は自転車だった。
examples.en: The first prize was a bicycle.

items.note: An object given as a prize. 賞金 = prize money. 商品 = merchandise.

mnemonic.meaning: Grain (穀) things (物). Cereals.
mnemonic.reading: COCK, MOATS (こくもつ): the rooster eats grain by the moat.

examples.ja: 米や麦などの穀物を育てている。
examples.en: They grow grains like rice and wheat.

items.note: Formal. Rice, wheat, corn, beans.

mnemonic.meaning: The car (車) starts (発). A departure.
mnemonic.reading: HA, SHA (はっしゃ): "Ha!" The train departs. Shaa!

examples.ja: 電車はまもなく発車します。
examples.en: The train will depart shortly.

items.note: Vehicles leaving. 出発 is anyone departing. 発車時刻 = departure time.

mnemonic.meaning: 茹 has 艹 (plant): vegetables in water. To boil.
mnemonic.reading: YOU, DAY RUE (ゆでる): you boil eggs all day and rue it.

examples.ja: 卵を十分間茹でた。
examples.en: I boiled the eggs for ten minutes.

items.note: Usually in kana: ゆでる. ゆで卵 = boiled egg. 煮る (Level 18) is simmering with seasoning.
